project_type: Full-stack monorepo: Node.js Express API + Vite React Admin + Expo React Native mobile
build_system: npm for all packages, Docker Compose for backend orchestration, Expo for mobile
test_framework: No test framework configured. Backend package.json test script is a stub.
build_command: cd admin && npm run build (admin); backend has no build step (ES modules); mobile uses expo start
test_command: No automated tests exist in this project
verification_instructions: 1. For backend: Run node --check on modified files to verify syntax. 2. For admin: Run npm run build to verify TypeScript compilation. 3. For mobile: Verify TypeScript compiles without errors using npx tsc --noEmit. 4. Runtime verification requires physical device (push notifications) or emulator.
setup_instructions: Backend: cd backend && npm install && npm run dev. Admin: cd admin && npm install && npm run dev. Mobile: cd mobile && npm install && npx expo start.
environment_constraints: No Docker daemon available in sandbox. No physical devices for push notification runtime testing. Use static analysis and TypeScript compilation for verification. No test suite exists.
contribution_requirements: Push to feature branch, never main. Runtime behavior overrides static analysis. Do not mark features complete without verification. Do not rewrite features that are already correct.
key_patterns: Backend: ES modules with named exports, Express route handlers, Mongoose models. Mobile: React Navigation (native-stack + bottom-tabs), Redux Toolkit with createAsyncThunk, services layer with axios. Admin: Vite + React 19, zustand state, tailwindcss styling.
directory_structure: Root contains: backend/ (Express API), admin/ (Vite React admin panel), mobile/ (Expo React Native app). Backend has modules: posts, users, notifications, admin, tags. Mobile has screens, components, services, store/slices, navigation, utils, theme.
